limitations: Vertical dimensions and roof pitches are photographically interpreted. Map heights explicitly marked approximate are not silently treated as survey data.
Frescoes, heraldry, figurative reliefs and detailed sculpture are not reproduced; maximum fidelity remains pending.

Reference photos remain research-only; shared procedural materials supply runtime surfaces.
